usageNotes: Use this to set or clear a single Ceph cluster flag (e.g., noout, nobackfill) during maintenance windows or incident response. Requires Sys.Modify at the root path and executes synchronously — no UPID is returned, so the change takes effect immediately. Always clear maintenance flags (noout, norebalance) after completing cluster work to restore normal data balancing.

examples.summary: Set noout flag to prevent OSDs from being marked out during a planned maintenance window

tips: noout is the most commonly used flag during OSD or host maintenance — it prevents Ceph from triggering data rebalancing when OSDs go offline.
pause halts both reads and writes cluster-wide; use only in emergencies as it causes full I/O stall.
This endpoint targets one flag at a time and is synchronous; the bulk PUT /cluster/ceph/flags endpoint sets multiple flags but forks an async worker task.
Forgetting to clear flags like noout or norebalance after maintenance leaves the cluster in a degraded-but-silent state where failures won't trigger recovery.
